announcements.headline: EQS-News: Linde Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Results (Earnings Release Tables Attached)
announcements.insight: Linde reports third-quarter results following its second-quarter update. Shareholders should monitor future guidance for performance trends.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Linde Declares Dividend in Fourth Quarter 2026
announcements.insight: Linde declares a fourth quarter dividend, following previous quarterly payments in July and October. This continues the established pattern of regular shareholder distributions.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Linde Expands Supply of Industrial Gases to Tata Steel in India
announcements.insight: Linde expands industrial gas supply to Tata Steel in India. This follows its Q2 results and dividend declaration, indicating continued operational growth.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Linde Announces Third Quarter 2026 Earnings and Conference Call Schedule
announcements.insight: Linde announces its third quarter earnings schedule. This follows the release of second-quarter results in July.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Linde Reports Second-Quarter 2026 Results (Earnings Release Tables Attached)
announcements.insight: Linde reports second-quarter results. This follows the earlier earnings date announcement and precedes the dividend declaration and semiconductor investment details.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Linde to Invest $1 Billion to Support Major U.S. Semiconductor Facility Expansion
announcements.insight: The $1 billion investment supports a major U.S. semiconductor facility expansion, indicating significant capital allocation following recent earnings and dividend declarations.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Linde Declares Dividend in Third Quarter 2026
announcements.insight: Linde declares a third quarter dividend. This follows its second quarter earnings announcement in July.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Linde Expands Renewable Energy Sourcing in its EMEA and APAC Regions
announcements.insight: Linde expands renewable energy sourcing in EMEA and APAC. This aligns with its sustainability reporting and FTSE4Good inclusion, supporting long-term ESG credentials rather than immediate financial impact.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Linde Marks 11th Consecutive Year in FTSE4Good Index Series
announcements.insight: Linde has been included in the FTSE4Good Index Series for an eleventh consecutive year. This follows its recent publication of a sustainable development report and second quarter earnings.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Linde Announces Second Quarter 2026 Earnings and Conference Call Schedule
announcements.insight: Linde announces its second quarter 2026 earnings and conference call schedule. This follows the publication of the 2025 Sustainable Development Report in June.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Linde Publishes 2025 Sustainable Development Report
announcements.insight: Linde published its 2025 Sustainable Development Report. Shareholders should monitor future filings for financial performance indicators linked to these sustainability metrics.
